checks: All corresponding canonical strings read. Exact index/sourceHash coverage; digit tokens, underscore blanks and placeholders checked. English quotations were checked against canonical role: English target text retained, Korean canonical meaning glosses localized. Canonical-full-English answer fragments retained. Source simplifications/issues separated from target changes.
genderPolicy: Existing unknowns retained. Source-explicit gender statements in local pronoun exercises preserved only in their source scope; not propagated to other occurrences of names.

exceptions.reason: Source presents a counterfactual inverse as equivalent to a causal statement; strict logical equivalence is not guaranteed.
False statement She study English. must stay uncorrected because it is the learner true/false target, not an author grammar error.
Artificial is not always fake or an exact antonym of authentic; source glossary simplification preserved and requires teacher review.
Omniscient vs limited point-of-view distinction is simplified; knowing two minds can involve variable focalization, so full passage/context matters.
Capital letters are not generally enlarged lowercase shapes; source mnemonic is unreliable for several letters. Translation follows source; teacher review recommended.
